content_sections.heading: CCS HAU Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. GPB/HAU/2026/A1/3254-3303 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download CCS HAU notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduated or Diploma holders in Agriculture Sciences Age limit: 21 to 45 years (as on last date of submission of application) Age relaxation: SC/BC etc. 3 years on the maximum age limit Other conditions: Must produce medical certificate of fitness from University CMO at joining. Must execute an agreement on Rs. 15 non-judicial stamp paper. Must sign a declaration of secrecy and non-disclosure agreement. Must report for duty within 10 days of appointment order.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment up to 31.03.2027 (likely to continue). Initial engagement for one year, extendable for two more years (one year at a time) subject to requirement and satisfactory performance. Maximum duration of engagement three years (1+1+1) or duration of the research project, whichever is earlier. Services may be terminated at any time without reason on non-release of funds by the funding agency. Selected candidate may leave after giving one month's notice in writing to the University. Agreement on Non judicial Stamped paper of Rs. 15/- to be executed before joining.

content_sections.heading: How Will CCS HAU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Interview Interview on 21.11.2026 at 9:30 A.M. in the office of Director of Research, CCS HAU, Hisar. No separate letter for interview will be issued. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application on the proforma at Annexure-A Attested passport size photograph No objection certificate from present employer, if applicable Original certificates to be produced at the interview Certified true copies or original certificates to be submitted to the University

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CCS HAU Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the application on the attached proforma (Annexure-A) with an attested passport size photograph. Send the application complete in all respects to the office of the Professor & Head (Genetics & Plant Breeding), CCS HAU, Hisar. The application must be received by 20.11.2026 up to 10:00 A.M.; no application thereafter will be entertained. Attend the interview on 21.11.2026 at 9:30 A.M. in the office of Director of Research, CCS HAU, Hisar; no separate letter will be issued.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Not treated as a regular employee; not entitled to CPF/GPF or other benefits of regular employees. Must comply with the Standards of Conduct; failure is a ground for termination without notice.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CCS HAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CCS HAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 13 vacancies for YP-I.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CCS HAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-A attached to the notification (page 3)) and send it to Office of the Professor & Head (Genetics & Plant Breeding), Department of Genetics & Plant Breeding, CCS HAU, Hisar, by by hand or post, to reach by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 45 years (as on last date of submission of application). Relaxation: SC/BC etc. 3 years on the maximum age limit.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 30000 per month (fixed/consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduated or Diploma holders in Agriculture Sciences.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must produce medical certificate of fitness from University CMO at joining. Must execute an agreement on Rs. 15 non-judicial stamp paper. Must sign a declaration of secrecy and non-disclosure agreement. Must report for duty within 10 days of appointment order.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Interview on 21.11.2026 at 9:30 A.M. in the office of Director of Research, CCS HAU, Hisar. No separate letter for interview will be issued. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment up to 31.03.2027 (likely to continue). Initial engagement for one year, extendable for two more years (one year at a time) subject to requirement and satisfactory performance. Maximum duration of engagement three years (1+1+1) or duration of the research project, whichever is earlier.
